operations_annual_plan_section_subject_c.name: operations_annual_plan_section_subject_check
operations_annual_plan_section_subject_c.value: ("operations_annual_plan"."subject_id" IS NOT NULL OR "operations_annual_plan"."category_id" IS NULL)

operations_annual_plan_block_slot_check.name: operations_annual_plan_block_slot_check
operations_annual_plan_block_slot_check.value: ("operations_annual_plan_block"."start_slot" IS NULL AND "operations_annual_plan_block"."end_slot" IS NULL AND "operations_annual_plan_block"."promotion_ranges" IS NULL) OR ("operations_annual_plan_block"."start_slot" IS NOT NULL AND "operations_annual_plan_block"."end_slot" IS NOT NULL AND "operations_annual_plan_block"."promotion_ranges" IS NOT NULL AND "operations_annual_plan_block"."start_slot" BETWEEN 1 AND 24 AND "operations_annual_plan_block"."end_slot" BETWEEN "operations_annual_plan_block"."start_slot" AND 24)

operations_annual_plan_block_rule_check.name: operations_annual_plan_block_rule_check
operations_annual_plan_block_rule_check.value:
(
        ("operations_annual_plan_block"."rule_type" IS NULL AND "operations_annual_plan_block"."monthly_frequency" IS NULL AND "operations_annual_plan_block"."quantity_parts" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("operations_annual_plan_block"."rule_type" = 'flexible' AND "operations_annual_plan_block"."monthly_frequency" > 0 AND "operations_annual_plan_block"."quantity_parts" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("operations_annual_plan_block"."rule_type" = 'fixed' AND "operations_annual_plan_block"."monthly_frequency" IS NULL
          AND cardinality("operations_annual_plan_block"."quantity_parts") > 0 AND 0 < ALL("operations_annual_plan_block"."quantity_parts"))
      )

operations_schedule_promotion_consistenc.name: operations_schedule_promotion_consistency_check
operations_schedule_promotion_consistenc.value:
(
        ("operations_content_schedule"."is_promoted" = false AND "operations_content_schedule"."promotion_status" = 'none')
        OR
        ("operations_content_schedule"."is_promoted" = true AND "operations_content_schedule"."promotion_status" IN (
          'pending', 'awaiting_promotion', 'testing', 'test_paused', 'test_pending', 'scaling', 'scaling_paused', 'waiting_action', 'ended', 'test_discarded', 'formal_discarded'
        ))
      )

operations_meeting_attachment_source_che.name: operations_meeting_attachment_source_check
operations_meeting_attachment_source_che.value: "operations_meeting_attachment"."source" IN ('image','manual','generated') AND ("operations_meeting_attachment"."source" = 'image' OR ("operations_meeting_attachment"."mime_type" = 'application/pdf' AND "operations_meeting_attachment"."meeting_version_id" IS NOT NULL))

operations_promotion_campaign_stage_chec.name: operations_promotion_campaign_stage_check
operations_promotion_campaign_stage_chec.value:
(
        ("operations_promotion_campaign"."current_status" IN ('testing','test_paused','test_pending') AND "operations_promotion_campaign"."current_stage" = 'testing')
        OR ("operations_promotion_campaign"."current_status" IN ('scaling','scaling_paused') AND "operations_promotion_campaign"."current_stage" = 'scaling')
        OR ("operations_promotion_campaign"."current_status" = 'waiting_action' AND "operations_promotion_campaign"."current_stage" IN ('testing', 'scaling'))
        OR ("operations_promotion_campaign"."current_status" IN ('ended', 'test_discarded', 'formal_discarded') AND "operations_promotion_campaign"."current_stage" IS NULL)
      )

operations_promotion_daily_kind_check.name: operations_promotion_daily_kind_check
operations_promotion_daily_kind_check.value: "operations_promotion_daily_metric"."record_kind" IN ('regular','test_residual') AND ("operations_promotion_daily_metric"."record_kind" <> 'test_residual' OR ("operations_promotion_daily_metric"."stage_type_snapshot"='testing' AND "operations_promotion_daily_metric"."source_stage_started_on" IS NOT NULL AND "operations_promotion_daily_metric"."review_decision"='test_discarded'))

operations_promotion_start_plan_pair_che.name: operations_promotion_start_plan_pair_check
operations_promotion_start_plan_pair_che.value: ("operations_promotion_start_plan"."planned_on" IS NULL) = ("operations_promotion_start_plan"."planned_stage" IS NULL) AND ("operations_promotion_start_plan"."planned_stage" IS NULL OR "operations_promotion_start_plan"."planned_stage" IN ('testing','scaling')) AND ("operations_promotion_start_plan"."planned_on" IS NULL OR "operations_promotion_start_plan"."waiting_through" IS NULL OR "operations_promotion_start_plan"."planned_on" > "operations_promotion_start_plan"."waiting_through")

operations_promotion_wait_decision_check.name: operations_promotion_wait_decision_check
operations_promotion_wait_decision_check.value: ("operations_promotion_wait_range"."next_decision" IS NULL AND "operations_promotion_wait_range"."next_effective_on" IS NULL) OR ("operations_promotion_wait_range"."next_decision" IS NOT NULL AND "operations_promotion_wait_range"."next_effective_on" IS NOT NULL AND (("operations_promotion_wait_range"."stage_type" = 'testing' AND "operations_promotion_wait_range"."next_decision" IN ('test_continue','restart_testing','start_scaling','test_discarded')) OR ("operations_promotion_wait_range"."stage_type" = 'scaling' AND "operations_promotion_wait_range"."next_decision" IN ('scaling_continue','formal_discarded','ended'))))
